title: 11 Best Cendol in Penang
description: The best cendol in Penang, Malaysia.

places.name: Penang Road Famous Teochew Chendul
places.address: 27-29, Lebuh Keng Kwee, George Town, 10100 Penang

redditQuotes.text: Penang Road Famous Teochew Cendol in Georgetown was a revelation — ended up going back to back 3 times.
OG Penang Road Teochew Cendol slaps tbh

places.verdict: The OG since 1936 — the single most famous cendol stall in all of Malaysia.

comparison.best for: The definitive Penang cendol with bold gula melaka and rich santan
comparison.strengths: 4.1★ from 8,406 reviews · Heritage since 1936 · Multiple branches
comparison.limitations: Tiny portions, no seating, long queues
comparison.what to order: Classic Chendul (RM4.50) — shaved ice with pandan jelly, coconut milk, gula melaka. Try the Penang Trio.

places.whatToOrder: Classic Chendul (RM4.50) — shaved ice with pandan jelly, coconut milk, gula melaka. Try the Penang Trio.

places.name: Penang Road Famous Chendul (Nyonya Cendol)
places.address: 27, Lebuh Keng Kwee, George Town, 10100 Penang

redditQuotes.text: Some say this one is better and is better supported by locals.
You won't miss out — some say it's even better!

places.verdict: The underdog rival across the alley — locals swear this has bolder gula melaka and shorter queues.

comparison.best for: Less crowded alternative with arguably richer gula melaka
comparison.strengths: Bold gula melaka · Shorter queues · Same legendary alley
comparison.what to order: Classic cendol with extra gula melaka — locals prefer this for richer palm sugar syrup.

places.whatToOrder: Classic cendol with extra gula melaka — locals prefer this for richer palm sugar syrup.

places.name: Swatow Lane Ice Kacang

redditQuotes.text: Great if you don't want overly sweet cendol.

places.verdict: Evening cendol — open until 9:30 PM with spacious outdoor seating. Milder, perfect after dinner.

comparison.best for: Evening cendol with spacious open-air seating
comparison.strengths: 4.2★ · Open late · Beautiful landscaped outdoor seating
comparison.limitations: Gula melaka flavor milder than others
comparison.what to order: Cendol with thick red bean paste and plump jellies. Rojak with prawn paste also popular.

places.whatToOrder: Cendol with thick red bean paste and plump jellies. Rojak with prawn paste also popular.

places.name: Ais Tingkap

redditQuotes.text: This drink is unique to Penang — definitely worth the wait!
Famous spots include Ais Tingkap on Lebuh Tamil.

places.verdict: Multi-generational family famous for Ais Sarbat — a unique pink rose drink found only in Penang.

comparison.best for: Pairing cendol with Penang's unique Ais Sarbat rose drink
comparison.strengths: 4.2★ from 1,904 reviews · Unique Ais Sarbat · Family-run
comparison.limitations: Long queues, cendol secondary to Ais Sarbat
comparison.what to order: Ais Sarbat (RM2.50) — rose syrup, basil seeds, coconut seeds. Get cendol alongside.

places.whatToOrder: Ais Sarbat (RM2.50) — rose syrup, basil seeds, coconut seeds. Get cendol alongside.

places.name: Penang Road Famous Ice Kacang Cendol (Tan Jetty)

redditQuotes.text: Better than the best of Penang's chendol — managed by an elderly couple.

places.verdict: Best-kept secret — elderly couple at Tan Jetty. Higher-rated than the original, RM3 per bowl.

comparison.best for: Affordable cendol (RM3) while exploring clan jetties
comparison.limitations: Closed Wednesdays, may sell out early
comparison.what to order: Classic cendol at RM3 — many reviewers say this beats the original.

places.whatToOrder: Classic cendol at RM3 — many reviewers say this beats the original.

places.name: Relau 88 Laksa & Ice Kacang
places.address: Persiaran Paya Terubong 2, 11900 Bayan Lepas, Penang

redditQuotes.text: Homemade palm sugar gives it a distinctive flavor unlike other cendol in Penang.

places.verdict: Locals-only gem in Bayan Lepas — homemade palm sugar, garden setting, killer laksa.

comparison.best for: Homemade palm sugar cendol in a garden setting
comparison.strengths: 4.3★ · Homemade palm sugar · Beautiful garden · Amazing laksa
comparison.limitations: Far from George Town, only open Wed-Sun
comparison.what to order: Cendol with homemade palm sugar. Get the Penang laksa too.

places.whatToOrder: Cendol with homemade palm sugar. Get the Penang laksa too.

places.name: Kulim Road Best Cendol

redditQuotes.text: I personally think it's much better than Penang cendol.
Gula melaka is extremely fragrant, red bean texture just right.

places.verdict: Mainland dark horse many locals rate above Penang Road — incredibly fragrant gula melaka.

comparison.best for: Most fragrant gula melaka cendol with optional pulut
comparison.strengths: 4.4★ · Old Malay couple · Fresh coconut milk · Pulut option
comparison.limitations: Mainland Bukit Mertajam — 45 min from George Town
comparison.what to order: Cendol with pulut (black glutinous rice). Request 'kurang manis' if too sweet.

places.whatToOrder: Cendol with pulut (black glutinous rice). Request 'kurang manis' if too sweet.

places.name: Tony Ais Kacang & Cendol

redditQuotes.text: Batu Lanchang Tony Ais Kacang is one of Penang's famous Chendul spots.

places.verdict: Batu Lanchang neighborhood staple — generous portions, zero tourists.

comparison.best for: Generous ice kacang and cendol in a local neighborhood
comparison.strengths: Neighborhood institution · Generous portions · No tourists
comparison.limitations: Fewer reviews, not in George Town
comparison.what to order: Ice kacang (mountains of shaved ice) plus cendol. Get both.

places.whatToOrder: Ice kacang (mountains of shaved ice) plus cendol. Get both.

places.name: OO White Coffee (Waterfall)

redditQuotes.text: Cendul at OO cafe — double the price but brown sugar syrup taste much better.

places.verdict: Penang's highest-rated kopitiam — cendol reportedly beats the tourist-famous original.

comparison.best for: Superior cendol in a full kopitiam with white coffee
comparison.strengths: 4.6★ from 3,071 reviews · Full kopitiam menu · Open 7 AM
comparison.what to order: White coffee first, then cendol. Brown sugar syrup reportedly richer than Penang Road's.

places.whatToOrder: White coffee first, then cendol. Brown sugar syrup reportedly richer than Penang Road's.

redditQuotes.text: Solid spot near Batu Ferringhi for traditional cendol.

places.verdict: Beach-area cendol near Batu Ferringhi night market.

comparison.best for: Cendol near the beach and night market

redditQuotes.text: New Cendol House is a solid choice for fresh cendol near BM.

places.verdict: Mainland specialist in Bukit Mertajam — fresh cendol only BM locals know.

comparison.best for: Fresh cendol on the mainland near Bukit Mertajam
comparison.strengths: 4.3★ · Fresh daily ingredients · Mainland hidden gem
